name: GSGEN
aliases: GSGEN: A method introducing 3D SDS loss based on Point-E
definition: A method introducing 3D SDS loss based on Point-E to mitigate the multi-face or Janus problem in text-to-3D generation.
summary: GSGEN is a text-to-3D method using 3D Gaussians optimized via 3D SDS loss to incorporate direct geometry priors and alleviate the Janus problem.
